transcript.text: welcome back to the channel today we talk about risk
the market gives you nothing for free
think in R multiples not dollars
a one R loss should never hurt
expectancy is win rate times average win minus loss rate times average loss
most traders ignore transaction costs
slippage kills small account scalping
backtests overfit all the time
walk forward testing is the honest test
